items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: Miss Margaret Kimball, she was a regular pianist in his band, and they had Kimball, the trumpet player, the wife and the husband playing in the band. So I played at her place

ctx.x: Was Professor John Robichaud your uncle, and that was your father's brother?
Yeah, it was my father's brother, that was my uncle.
